t: A $(item)Harvesting Drone/$ is a specialized non-programmable type of $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$ which will carry out $(l:programming/harvest)crop/tree harvesting/$ tasks in a 17x17x17 cube centered on the block it's deployed at. The Drone will $(italic)not/$ pick up harvested items.
$(item)收割无人机/$是一种专门的、不可编程的$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$，会在以其部署所在方块为中心的 17x17x17 立方体范围内执行$(l:programming/harvest)收割作物/树木/$的任务。该无人机$(italic)不会/$拾取收获的物品。

As with all types of Drone, these drones require $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$ to operate, and will automatically seek out $(l:tools/drone#charging)a Charging Station with a Dispenser Upgrade/$ if low on air.
与所有类型的雄蜂一样，这些雄蜂需要$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$才能运作，并且在气压不足时会自动寻找$(l:tools/drone#charging)装有发射器升级的充气站/$。

If you deploy the $(item)Harvesting Drone/$ by $(thing)sneak+right-clicking/$ it against an inventory containing (only) a $(item)Hoe/$ of any type, the drone will use that hoe to automatically replant crops, and will not attempt to do any work without a hoe equipped. If you don't care about replanting, just deploy the drone against any other block.
如果你将$(item)收割无人机/$通过$(thing)潜行右击/$的方式部署到一个容器上，且该容器中（仅）包含任意类型的$(item)锄/$，那么无人机会使用那把锄头自动重新种植作物；如果没有装备锄头，它将不会尝试进行任何工作。如果你不在意重新种植，只需将无人机部署到其他任意方块上即可。
Note that Harvesting Drones have figured out how to chop down trees with a hoe instead of an axe; they're clever like that.
注意，收割无人机已经学会了用锄头而不是斧来砍树；它们就是这么聪明。
